v2.5.0: Eldritch Invocations and Metamagic

Two new world settings, both off by default, under the new Class Features heading in the module settings. Like the rest of the automation, they run only without Midi-QoL.

Eldritch Invocations

  • Eldritch Blast:
    • Agonizing Blast: + your Charisma modifier to each beam's damage.
    • Eldritch Spear: 300 ft (2014), or +30 ft per Warlock level (2024), unless dnd5e's own enchantment already changed the range.
    • Repelling Blast: asks whether to push the target 10 ft away.
    • Grasp of Hadar: asks whether to pull the target 10 ft, once per turn.
    • Lance of Lethargy: −10 ft speed, once per turn.
  • Pact weapon hits:
    • Eldritch Smite: offered like Divine Smite; afterwards asks whether to knock the target Prone.
    • Lifedrinker: 2014: Charisma modifier as necrotic damage on every hit. 2024: once per turn, asks the damage type, then offers a Hit Die to heal.
    • Improved Pact Weapon: +1 to attack and damage with a non-magical pact weapon.
  • Defence:
    • Protection of the Talisman: +1d4, offered after a failed save.
    • Rebuke of the Talisman and Tomb of Levistus: reactions (need Reaction Prompts on).
    • Gift of the Protectors: asks the warlock whether a creature that just dropped to 0 HP is in their book.
  • Cloak of Flies: poison damage at the start of a nearby creature's turn.
  • Maddening Hex: damages your Hex target and the creatures you pick next to it.

Full details in the release notes.
